description: Sign this computer in to the developer's tday account with a code. Returns a link and a code for the developer to approve on any device where they are signed in to tday (this computer's browser opens too when it has one, so it works from a sandbox, a cloud machine or SSH); show them both, then call it again while it says it is still waiting. Use it when a tday tool says there is no tday login. Saves the login to ~/.tday/config.json, where every tday server on this computer reads it.
name: tday_sign_in
title: Sign in to tday
